claims: Stephen F. Austin State University is a public university in Nacogdoches, Texas.
Stephen F. Austin State University was founded in 1923.
Stephen F. Austin State University features the Lumberjacks athletics program.
Stephen F. Austin State Park is located in Austin County, TX.
San Felipe de Austin State Historic Site is located in Austin County, TX.
The main campus of Stephen F. Austin State University is in Nacogdoches, East Texas.
Stephen F. Austin State University competes in basketball.
Stephen F. Austin State University competes in football.
Stephen F. Austin State University competes in baseball.
Stephen F. Austin State University competes in volleyball.
Stephen F. Austin State University competes in soccer.
Stephen F. Austin State University sports teams are often known as the "Jacks" or "Ladyjacks".
The Lumberjacks participate in the Southland Conference.
San Felipe de Austin State Historic Site is situated near the Brazos River.
San Felipe de Austin State Historic Site was the headquarters for Stephen F. Austin's colony in Mexican Texas.
San Felipe de Austin State Historic Site was established in 1823.
Stephen F. Austin lived from 1793 to 1836.
Stephen F. Austin was a known empresario.
Stephen F. Austin was known as the "father of Texas".
